description: This is a Java source file defining the NotificationService class, which manages user notifications including creation, listing, marking as read, and deletion.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: A service class to handle CRUD operations for user notifications in a Spring application.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new notification based on the provided request.

methods.name: listForUser
methods.description: Lists notifications for a specific user, ordered by creation time descending.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a notification as read or unread based on the provided ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a notification by its ID.
